\title "Loop edge 07: meters and free time"
\tempo 120
.
\ts 4 4 :4 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 |
\ts 3 4 :4 0.1 r 2.1 |
\ts 6 8 :8 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 3.1 2.1 |
\ts 5 8 :8 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 7.1 |
\ts 7 8 :8 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 7.1 5.1 3.1 |
\ts 2 2 :2 0.1 3.1 |
\ts 12 8 :4 0.1{d} 2.1{d} 3.1{d} 5.1{d} |
\ts 1 4 :4 0.1 |
\ts 4 4 \ft :4 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 |

\ts 3 8 \ro :8 0.1 2.1 3.1 |
\ts 9 8 \rc 2 :4 0.1{d} 2.1{d} 3.1{d}
